  context={"endpoint"}
>

Writes osapi-net.ipv4.ip_forward.conf for net.ipv4.ip_forward to behaviors.sysctl.dir, /etc/sysctl.d by default, and applies it with sysctl -p. It fails when sysctl -p fails, because the value is not set. A second run with the same value changes nothing and reports changed: false. If the kernel has a different value, for example after a failed apply, it applies the value again.
